title: Google Software Engineering Internship, Summer 2025
location: Mountain View, CA, USA / Remote Options

title: Gates Cambridge Scholarship 2025
eligibility: Citizens of any country outside the United Kingdom applying for a full-time postgraduate degree at Cambridge.
qualification: Outstanding academic excellence, clear reasons for choice of course, leadership capacity, and commitment to improving lives.
description: Full-cost scholarships for postgraduate study in any subject available at the University of Cambridge for academically outstanding international students.

title: Remote Frontend Engineer

qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience building complex web user interfaces.
description: Build user-friendly web applications, portals, and dashboard interfaces for Ubuntu open-source platforms and enterprise infrastructure tools.

title: Microsoft Imagine Cup 2025

title: Associate Product Manager (APM)
